An original young woman with long,
wavy light brown hair in a half-up style
wears a dusty pink long-sleeve top with
thin tonal seams and a short cream
sweater skirt with a cloud-like pattern.
Cream ribbed tights and gray chunky leg
warmers. A gray puffer bag hangs from
one shoulder, and gray chunky sneakers
complete the look. Her expression is
calm. Plain white studio backdrop, even
light. Palette of dusty pink, gray, and
cream. Playful and cozy, in the style of a
Y2K-inspired lookbook.
